$comment: Automata routine custom-config mappings. The frontend loads this file at startup. Each entry under 'routines' maps a routine key (the 'key' field on a Routine entity) to a typed form spec. When the user picks a routine in the job creation form, the spec is used to render a typed form; if no spec exists for a routine, a raw JSON editor is shown instead.

field_metadata.key: Required. JSON key the value is written to.
field_metadata.label: Required. Human label shown in the form.
field_metadata.required: Optional boolean. If true, submission is blocked when empty.
field_metadata.default: Optional. Pre-filled initial value when the form opens. No validation effect.
field_metadata.locked: Optional boolean. If true, field shows the default and cannot be edited by the user.
field_metadata.min: Optional. For integer/number fields: minimum allowed value.
field_metadata.max: Optional. For integer/number fields: maximum allowed value.
field_metadata.pattern: Optional. For string fields: regex string the value must match.
field_metadata.help: Optional. Tooltip / helper text shown below the input.
field_metadata.options: Required for enum/enum-multi. Array of { value, label } pairs.
field_metadata.visibleWhen: Optional. Conditional visibility — { field: 'otherKey', equals: <val> } or { field: 'otherKey', in: [<val>, ...] }.
field_metadata.fields: Required for object. Array of nested field specs.
field_metadata.itemFields: Required for array-of-objects. Array of nested field specs that each list item will use.

sql-injection-time-based.title: SQL Injection (time-based)
sql-injection-time-based.description: Detects SQL injection by inducing controllable delays in the database.

fields.label: Injection delay (seconds)
fields.help: Seconds the payload should sleep to confirm a positive response.

open-redirect.title: Open Redirect
open-redirect.description: Tests redirect parameters for unvalidated destinations.

fields.label: Target domain
fields.help: The external host the test will try to redirect to.
